component.name: Plainmark
component.summary: Read and edit local Markdown documents

description.p: Plainmark is a free Markdown viewer and visual editor for notes, documents and technical writing. Your files stay on your computer, with no accounts, ads, subscriptions or telemetry.

ul.li: Edit formatted documents or Markdown source with a synchronized preview
Organize local files in folder workspaces and tabs
Render Mermaid diagrams, math and local images
Find documents, follow local note links, and print or save a PDF

description.p: The current release is a preview. Unsaved recovery copies are stored locally without encryption and can be disabled or cleared in Privacy settings.

screenshot.caption: Write and read a local Markdown document
